name: Sulfate/Sulfamate Force Field Benchmark for GAGs
description: Assesses and validates newly developed sulfate and sulfamate force field parameters by comparing ab initio molecular dynamics–derived electrostatic interaction metrics for glycosaminoglycans.
evaluation_method: RMSE and correlation coefficients between force-field-derived and ab initio electrostatic interaction metrics (e.g., interaction energies, electrostatic potentials)
general_score_metric: RMSE of electrostatic interaction metrics (and correlation with ab initio reference)
reputation: Niche, specialist benchmark used primarily by computational chemistry groups developing and validating force-field parameters for glycosaminoglycans.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific and computationally expensive (ab initio reference). Small, specialized dataset; results sensitive to QM level of theory and simulation settings.
